title: Where the 1s electron is
caption: The radial probability distribution 4πr²ψ² for hydrogen's 1s electron. The electron is most likely to be found at the Bohr radius, a₀ = 52.9 pm, but there is a spread of distances: the quantum model replaces a fixed orbit with a probability.
alt: Probability against distance from the nucleus in units of a₀: zero at the nucleus, a peak at 1 a₀, and a long tail.
description: A tail stretching out several a₀.

checks.name: the most probable distance is the Bohr radius, r = a₀
